message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **federal statutory holidays in Canada that create long weekends in 2023**.  
(If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can adjust the list accordingly.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Family Day** | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18–20 (Sat–Sun–Mon) | Observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario, and Manitoba (except Manitoba’s own holiday). |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sat–Sun) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Mon) | May 20–22 (Sat–Sun–Mon) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Sun–Mon) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Sun–Mon) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Mon) | Nov 9–11 (Sat–Sun–Mon) | Observed nationwide. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Sun–Mon) | Observed nationwide. |

### Quick Summary

- **Family Day** – Feb 18‑20  
- **Good Friday** – Apr 7‑9  
- **Victoria Day** – May 20‑22  
- **Labour Day** – Sep 2‑4  
- **Thanksgiving** – Oct 7‑9  
- **Remembrance Day** – Nov 9‑11  
- **Christmas Day** – Dec 23‑25  

These are the only federal holidays in 2023 that produce a three‑day weekend (Saturday‑Sunday‑holiday). If you need provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) or a more detailed breakdown, just let me know!
